conviction_note: No pre-release and no Información Privilegiada since March, so Q3 and the reiteration-or-trim of a FY26 guide that still needs a sharp H2 step-up (adj EBITDA margin >=25% after 23.9% in H1; FCF pre-M&A EUR500-575m after EUR91m) are all new on Nov 2 after the close. abs_move 6.0 sits between the measured European base for new numbers (7%) and Grifols' own observed median results reaction of 4.2% over eight prints (my calculation from Yahoo closes on the issuer's release dates; max +14.3%). p_up 44: a mild lean down, resting on a peer read-across (Takeda, Oct 29: IVIG 'market and price dynamics', albumin forecast cut) and a 48-day Canadian collection pause the company has not sized, against a stock that ran up 14.9% in 20 days with no news I could find. The findings sum (-1.5) and the scaled number (-0.72) agree in sign; they differ because every finding is a proxy or an inference and none is a company number the market has not seen.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue, adj EBITDA and margin against a sourced bar of EUR1,960m / EUR519m / 26.4%. Slight miss risk on albumin and IVIG pricing (Takeda read-across) and Canada idle costs; partly offset by an FX tailwind (EUR/USD averaged 1.1506 in Q3-26 against 1.1689 in Q3-25, the first y/y USD tailwind in several quarters).

FY26 margin >=25% and FCF EUR500-575m reiterated or trimmed. This is the main source of the move. A reiteration is mildly positive because some sell-side (R4 24.8%) already sits below the margin guide; a trim of either line is the large negative tail. Expect a reiteration with tighter language more likely than not, but the trim risk is real.
Q3 FCF pre-M&A against a bar of ~EUR202m, more than double H1's EUR91m. Working capital in Q3 decides whether the FY FCF range is still credible. Direction unknown.

Update on the US Biopharma IPO timetable (signalled for end-Q3 2026 in March, reported as 2027 in the press since), a quantified Canada pause impact, and Egypt (the first phase of the industrial complex was due to open in October). Direction unknown.

findings.finding: Takeda, the closest listed plasma peer, reported on Oct 29 (after Grifols' last release) that IVIG revenue declined in H1 FY26 'as a result of the phasing as well as market and price dynamics', warned of a 'supply-demand dynamic change emerging' in immunoglobulin, and cut its albumin forecast on 'stronger-than-expected cost containment measures in China'. That is a negative read for Grifols' Q3 IVIG pricing and for its plan for H2 albumin to match H2-25 in absolute terms.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: IG is Grifols' growth engine: H1-26 IG +12.8% cc with albumin -14.2% cc, and the stock rose +3.67% on that release. When albumin was weak in Q1-26 the stock fell -2.36% (my calculation from Yahoo closes, release 2026-05-07).
findings.why_not_priced: It may be priced. GRF rose +2.48% on Oct 30, the session after Takeda reported, and Takeda's own stock rose, so the market did not read it as negative for the sector. If the read-across were priced as a threat, GRF would have lagged on Oct 30, which it did not. Kept small because the transmission is a peer to company hypothesis and Grifols has been taking IG share (H1 IG +12.8% against Takeda roughly flat).
findings.independence: Renta 4's Jul 29 note gives the H2 albumin plan this tests: 'una previsión para albúmina similar a 2S25 en términos absolutos una vez que se anualice el impacto negativo de China' (https://www.r4.com/articulos-y-analisis/valores/grifols-2t26-trimestre-en-linea-aunque-dependiente-del-2s26-para-alcanzar-los-objetivos-del-ano). That is the bar, not corroboration; no second source points the same way.

findings.finding: The FY26 guide needs a steep H2. Adj EBITDA margin must go from 23.9% in H1 to >=25% for the year (about 26% in H2), and FCF pre-M&A from EUR91m in H1 to EUR500-575m (EUR409-484m in H2). Renta 4's own model already sits below the margin guide at 24.8%, and the consensus Q3 bar asks for 26.4% margin and EUR202m FCF. So the Q3 release decides whether the guide holds, and the downside tail (a trim) is larger than the upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide reiterated with an in-line quarter: H1-26 +3.67%. Guide reiterated but the quarter called 'algo débiles' against consensus: Q1-26 -2.36%. FY25 (new-year guide) -3.97%. The new 2029 plan in Feb 2025 +14.32%. All my calculations from Yahoo closes on the issuer's release dates.
findings.original_quote: Grifols ha reiterado la guía de 2026 de margen EBITDA ajustado >25% (vs 24,8% R4e y después de 23,9% en 1S26) y FCF pre-M&A de 500-575 mln eur (vs ~560 mln eur R4e y después de 91 mln eur en 1S26), necesitando una mayor recuperación en la segunda mitad del año. [Translation: Grifols reiterated its 2026 guide of adj EBITDA margin >25% (vs 24.8% R4e, after 23.9% in H1) and FCF pre-M&A of EUR500-575m (vs ~EUR560m R4e, after EUR91m in H1), needing a stronger recovery in the second half.]
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public, but the stock ran up 14.9% in 20 days into the print, which is not what a market braced for a trim looks like. Sell-side ratings refreshed on Oct 26-29 are mostly Buy, with targets EUR10-23 (Euroland). If the trim risk were priced, the stock would be flat or down into the print, and it is near its best close since February.
findings.independence: The H1 6-K itself shows the 23.9% margin, the EUR91m FCF and 'Grifols confirms its guidance for the full year 2026' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438569/000110465926087634/tm2621481d1_6k.htm), which is the same fact base. The Q3 bar of 26.4% / EUR202m is from Benzinga ES (snippet only).

findings.finding: Grifols paused plasma collection at all its Canadian centres on Aug 14 after a Health Canada non-compliance notice, and the pause covered 48 days of Q3. Per Benzinga ES only two of 17 centres had resumed by Oct 20, and Grifols has not quantified the cost. The idle centre cost lands in Q3 COGS or adjustments, and lost liters raise future cost per liter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The closest precedent is the US centre closures (29 centres, Apr 2026). Grifols booked the cost in adjustments (Q2 adj EBITDA carried EUR39m of adjustments, the closures the main one) and the stock rose +3.67% on that print, so the market looked through a centre one-off once already.
findings.why_not_priced: The pause is public and named in the Spanish preview as one of the three things the print turns on, so most of it is priced. What is unpriced is the number: 'La compañía no ha cuantificado el efecto del cierre, que abarcó 48 días del tercer trimestre' (Benzinga ES snippet). Kept small, and likely classified as an adjustment, so it may not reach adj EBITDA at all. Canada is about 17 of more than 400 centres, so the rest of the company has to absorb only a small amount.
findings.independence: Benzinga ES, 2026-10-27 (snippet only, 403): 'Grifols reanudó el 20 de octubre la recogida de plasma en dos de sus 17 centros de Canadá, cerrados desde el 14 de agosto' (https://es.benzinga.com/news/spain/stocks/grifols-resultados-canada-margen-deuda-271026). That is a different source for the same fact, not independent evidence on its size.

baseline_tension: What I found leans mildly against the run-up: the stock rose 14.9% into a print whose guide needs a steep H2 and whose peer read is soft. So it agrees with the run-up-only priced lean (-0.745), which is the free control and earns nothing. None of it is a company-level number the market has not seen.
language_note: Renta 4's Spanish post-H1 note was the only source that put a sell-side number BELOW the margin guide (24.8% R4e vs >=25%) and spelled out the H2 levers, including the albumin target of matching H2-25 in absolute terms. The English call coverage (Nasdaq/RTT) carried only 'reiterated guidance'.

The Spanish Q3 preview (Benzinga ES, Oct 27) carried the only sourced Q3 bar I found (Euroland median of ten: EUR1,960m / EUR519m / 26.4% / EUR202m FCF) and the figure that only 2 of 17 Canadian centres had resumed by Oct 20. The English sources carried the Canada pause but no Q3 bar.
The issuer's Spanish calendar page confirmed the 17:35 CET timing word for word ('2 Noviembre 2026 a las 17:35 CET'), the same as the English page.
The Spanish press (Merca2) carried the IPO's slip toward 2027 with BofA; no English source found it.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'size the move on what is new': numbers are new and a guide trim is possible, so abs_move_pct went from 5.5 to 6.0, between the 7% European base for new numbers and the name's own observed 4.2% median.

'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company or a direct counterparty has said it': Takeda is a peer, not a counterparty, and GRF rose the day after, so finding 1 went from -0.6 to -0.4.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' (the market already looked through the US centre-closure one-off on H1): Canada finding went from -0.4 to -0.3, and p_up moved toward 50, from 43 to 44.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': finding 2 now states the FCF step-up (EUR409-484m in H2) beside the margin, and cash_flow is a separate new_in_release line. Its size is unchanged at -0.8.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the unexplained Oct 26 rally stays at 0 even though it agrees with the lean.
